title: Sennheiser Ambeo Max Soundbar $1499 Delivered @ Addicted to Audio
body:
Deal: Sennheiser Ambeo Max Soundbar $1499 Delivered @ Addicted to Audio

[elitistphoenix] Thanks! Duct taped it to the bonnet of my Hyundai Excel. Goes well with the pink under-body neons.
[esquared] Any feedback on these, seems like a good deal. Worth getting the subwoofer? (also on sale).
[y2k] I have it. It's ok, but to be honest, a little disappointing if you're looking for surround sound magic from a single unit. Also, while it does work with Google Home as a speaker, it is very unreliable.
That said, this is an amazing price!
[drprox] If someone is buying a soundbar looking for surround sound they have misunderstood..
[p3r514n] RTINGS Review: https://www.rtings.com/soundbar/reviews/sennheiser/ambeo-sou…
The Sennheiser AMBEO Soundbar MAX is great for mixed usage. It has a unique 3D mode that greatly improves the surround performance, which is great for movies. Its overall sound profile is pretty accurate, but it's lacking a bit in the bass range. While the bar still produces a good amount of bass, it's audibly lower than other frequencies at the same volume, which gives it a disappointing feel on stereo bass-heavy content like some music genres. On the upside, it has a room correction feature that adapts to your room and the reproduction of voices in accurate and clear.
8/10
[freefall101] No pass through hdmi 2.1 is a killer for me. Also there’s this angry review on reddit https://www.reddit.com/r/Soundbars/comments/1kjeuqq/must_rea…
Seems a few bugs with connectivity were never fixed.
[maverickjohn] 5 years ago I would have been all over this. Now it's still great sounding but has some limitations which is showing its age such as HDMI 2.1 passthrough. Still a great price at $1500 but the Samsung soundbars etc hold a better proposition with all their modern day features.
[drprox] Sorry can anyone tell me what exactly you mean by no HDMI 2.1 passthrough. I understand each of those individually but what I want is a nice soundbar I can use for my tv and occasionally for music. I just need the tv remote (or google tv remote) to have volume control really.
Edit - ok think I got it. To expand your HDMI inputs. Presumably mostly for consoles.
[maverickjohn] Yep your edit is correct.
You can't plug directly into your soundbar if you want to experience the benefits of HDMI 2.1.
You will be capped at HDMI 2.0 settings. So unlikely to get 4k at 120hz etc.
[R999R] Same price on Amazon
I went with them in case this thing craps itself - maybe easier returns process with Amazon.
Edit: and in typical buy-now-ask-questions-later I am doing more research…. this special pricing must be a thing to make space for a new Ambeo next year. Also, there is a software update for the Ambeo max from Aug 2025: https://newsroom.sennheiser.com/to-the-max-n1nxbh
I was thinking of a Krix lx7 and Anthem MRX combo but this Ambeo is cheap enough to try out.
[drprox] Bought, too tempting as wanted a sound bar and looks huge.
[pavman] Always sceptical of soundbars with built in subwoofers.. No matter what magic it does, it surely cannot replace a dedicated 8" plus subwoofer. And suppose you do add the wireless subwoofer in (which is also on sale), is the soundbar smart enough to direct low frequencies to the sub and make 'better' use of the drivers in the soundbar??
[jaejae69] Yes, a retail $4000 soundbar is absolutely “smart enough” to hand off low frequencies to a subwoofer. I have a Bose smart ultra soundbar and the Bose sub. The sub had an issue a while back where it turned on and was recognized by the soundbar but just produced no sound. There was a very noticeable lack of bass coming from the soundbar in this situation as it was still recognising the sub and handing off the low frequencies.
